sloka: अथाध्वनि गतौ विप्रौ विज्ञाय स नृगस्तदा ।आहूय मन्त्रिणः सर्वान्नैगमान्सपुरोधसः ।। ७.५४.५ ॥
transliteration: athādhvani gatau viprau vijñāya sa nṛgastadā ।āhūya mantriṇaḥ sarvānnaigamānsapurodhasaḥ ।। 7.54.5 ॥

translations.english: Then, having understood that the two Brahmins had departed, King Nṛga summoned all his ministers, citizens, and priests.
translations.hindi: मेरे आश्रित पुरवासी लोग सीता, भरत, लक्ष्मण और शत्रुन्न के विषय में क्या कहते है ?
